components.name: Setback jade wall
components.function: Need beveled/setback wall hosts, terrace/step returns, portal reveal/lotus crest seat and gold band corners. Existing jade/lotus/gold patterns retained, not recoloured to palace marble. Distinct jungle canopy/palms/vines/epiphytes and birds/geckos/beetles still require audit; shared moss/rocks/water reused. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated setback jade wall matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
